name: COASTAL Orange Beach
description: COASTAL Orange Beach provides a waterfront restaurant, an open-air bar, and a lifestyle store all with tremendous beachfront views. Located directly on the sugar white sands, COASTAL offers beachfront breakfast, lunch, and dinner service. The restaurant serves fresh local seafood and unique culinary items from award-winning chefs. The beachside bar features live music, tropical cocktails, and fresh Gulf dishes. COASTAL Store offers apparel, accessories, beach gear, and coastal lifestyle products.
